newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares climb, seen holding on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares climb, seen holding on Tuesday.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Monday and dealers expected more of the same on Tuesday, although they said there was a lack of clear direction, with some players holding back ahead of the first annual company reports due next month.
"It will probably be just as difuse a market tomorrow as today. There are no clear trends at the moment," a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index rose 0.56 point to 144.07 in low overall bourse turnover of 558 million crowns. Its March future rose 0.60 point to 144.00 with 130 contracts, each worth 100,000 crowns, traded.
Of the top 20 shares, 10 rose, five fell and five were unchanged.
Den Danske Bank and BG Bank both rose -- by two crowns to 500 and by three crowns to 292 respectively -- while the third of the big three, Unidanmark, stuck at 340 crowns.
Leading the losers were Coloplast, down nine crowns to 681 and Radiometer, down four crowns to 368 crowns.

Copenhagen Airports fell five crowns to 670 despite favourable analysis last week of the Danish aviation industry, but SAS managed a 0.5 crown rise to 81 crowns. --Uffe Hansen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969658
